icons.name: switch-voice
icons.heading: Switch voice
icons.description: The voice passes to the other speaker. Light: the voice marker leaps in an arc from speaker A and lands on speaker B with a hit; B's head and shoulders dip under it and rebound, and a sound arc swells off the side of B's head and fades as B starts speaking. Strong: the marker first presses down on A, who dips with it, and pushes off into a higher leap; it lands harder on B, who takes it in two beats, and B speaks twice. The marker stays on B. The reverse is the same hand-off back to A.

icons.name: voice-speed
icons.heading: Voice speed
icons.description: Speech speeds up. Light: Play gives one beat as the faster speed engages, and the cadence marks bunch up behind it like cars braking in a queue: the middle mark slams into its tighter slot first, the far one 70 ms later, each hitting home and rebounding once. Strong: Play gathers, then beats harder while the marks first spread out, drive in faster and rebound twice. The first mark never moves; the marks stay at the tighter spacing. The reverse is the exact time reversal: the marks relax back out, far one first.
